# Cleaning fixtures

These V5 saves contain one normally constructed household member beside a dirty
counter, table or bin. The number identifies the approach side, in the render
facing order positive X, negative X, positive Y, negative Y. They contain no
active chore; tests issue a real command after loading.

Regenerate with
`cargo run -p terri-wasm --example cleaning_animation_review -- web/tests/fixtures/cleaning-animation`.
The example checks that each command starts the expected animation and faces
its supporting object. Keep work durations, needs decay and activity ownership
on their production paths.
